addictionPotential: 滥用潜力中等至高，长期使用可产生心理依赖。
summary: 一种短效解离性麻醉剂和致幻剂，常用于急诊医学。是解离剂的代表性药物，在亚麻醉剂量下被广泛娱乐使用。小剂量类似酒精，较高剂量会使人失去行动能力并引发迷幻体验：所谓“K 洞”。
effectsSummary: At low doses: mild euphoria, dissociation, altered perception. At high doses: intense dissociative experience, out-of-body experiences, K-hole, loss of motor control.
dosageRemark: Low doses are social and functional. Higher doses quickly lead to dissociation and immobility.
generalRisks: Risk of accidents due to immobility and dissociation. Bladder and urinary tract damage with frequent use. Cognitive impairment.
longtermRisks: Frequent use can cause severe bladder damage (ketamine bladder syndrome), cognitive impairment, and memory loss.
saferUse: Lie down in a safe place if dissociating.
Have a sober sitter present for higher doses.
Avoid frequent use to protect bladder.
